noise_diagnostic.summary_text:
DIAGNOSTIC MULTI-FLUX - Analyse sur 6 flux

Score moyen de proxy de variance: 0.609 (échelle 0-1)
Score maximum: 0.902, Score minimum: 0.550

TOP 3 FLUX AVEC SIGNATURE CSD:
  1. susceptibility (score: 0.902)
     - Q5 ratio: 79.00 vs bruit blanc 0.14
     - Hurst max: 1.012, Pente FFT: -0.256
  2. fliprate (score: 0.550)
     - Q5 ratio: 9.44 vs bruit blanc 0.14
     - Hurst max: 1.105, Pente FFT: 0.051
  3. flip (score: 0.550)
     - Q5 ratio: 9.44 vs bruit blanc 0.14
     - Hurst max: 1.105, Pente FFT: 0.051

BOTTOM 3 FLUX (BRUIT BLANC):
  1. energy (score: 0.550)
     - Hurst moyen: 1.007
  2. magnetization (score: 0.550)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.937
  3. localvar (score: 0.550)
     - Hurst moyen: 1.009
